2988|00c35128.name: Morin Cloudstalker
2988|00c35128.text: The Outrunners' duty is to ensure the safety of those who travel across the plains of Mulgore. Those that would threaten the safety of the $r homeland risk punishment at our hands.

2993|f7a5deb4.name: Baine Bloodhoof
2993|f7a5deb4.text: The land has been good to our people, $c. We must be thankful for our good fortune.

3052|25d0fbd5.name: Skorn Whitecloud
3052|25d0fbd5.text: Come closer, young one.  In my time I could hear the flutter of a prey's beating heart, but now you must speak up if you want your words heard.

3064|400ae304.name: Gennia Runetotem
3064|400ae304.text: We work to preserve the balance as Cenarius teaches, $c.  His is the light of a beacon that shows the way for us, and we must do everything in our power to preserve that light.

3065|2d23ed1c.name: Yaw Sharpmane
3065|2d23ed1c.text: I do not have the knowledge you seek.

3066|1605f087.name: Narm Skychaser
3066|1605f087.text: The spirits have guided you to me. How may I be of service?

3067|0c543544.name: Pyall Silentstride
3067|0c543544.text: Cooking is a life long pursuit and I see we share the same passion!

6747|e013de07.name: Innkeeper Kauth
6747|e013de07.text: As the wind on the plains, you are always welcome here.

748-progress.name: Mull Thunderhorn
748-progress.text: Do you have the paws and talons, $N?
748-progress.title: Poison Water

96130-progress.name: Yaw Sharpmane
96130-progress.text: Have you found the big wolf?
96130-progress.title: Chakuyak

99080-complete.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99080-complete.text:
You are covered in centaur blood. Remember this feeling. It is an honor unlike any other among our people.

I could hear the moment the last fell, and their thunderous stampede echoed no longer. Well done!

Today marks a great victory for our village, and a sense of security our young ones need now more than ever. You have my deepest thanks, young $c.
99080-complete.title: Drive Them Out

99082-accept.name: Baine Bloodhoof
99082-accept.text:
Your bravery defending your people demands recognition. Journey to Thunder Bluff to the northwest, our mighty city whose shadow grants us shade in the warmer months, and seek audience with my father.

It was he who led the charge with the young Warchief Thrall to reclaim these plains and drive the centaur away for good. As High Chieftain, he will reward you generously for your part in ensuring his own bravery is honored.

You must take a lift to reach the High Chieftain, who sits on the central rise.
99082-accept.title: The High Chieftain
